name: Clement Ang
text:
30 July 2026: Survive Before You Thrive 🐻

Market Commentary:

Huge unwind day as equities saw strong bi-directional ranges perfect for day traders. This time, unlike just AI infra names, weakness have begun to seep into other parts of the market as well.

Looking at the dollar, the FOMC meeting induced a wedge drop through the 20-EMA; precious metals in relation continues to morph in its pattern, with Gold and Silver now starting to look like bottoming weekly price action - that said, be cognizant of it them still in structural downtrends.

Looking at crypto, similar sideways action as precious metals, but very messy and nothing of interest - all majors are in structural downtrends.

Certainly too late to be shorting at this juncture, being cognizant of violent snapbacks in stocks severely battered the past 2 weeks.

Notes:

> Absolute brutality in the AI infra land, with price action looking like investors getting out at any price. Unlike the past couple of market corrections, the damage looks pretty severe - suggesting at very least a long and drawn out correction.

> Certainly too late to be selling short in these names, however given the technical damage, any 'oversold' rallies will represent new spots to initiate shorts.

> Staying very light and small until an easier opportunity comes around. No point picking up pennies in front of a steamroller.

name: Clement Ang
text:
31 July 2026: Mean Reversion 🩹

Market Commentary:

Absolute face ripper for late shorts as the mean reversion in AI infra plays finally came (off the back that SALP liquidated their entire portfolio). Looking across individual equities, still a lack of constructive weekly bases out there that would construe a potential theme and healthy leadership - though that can potentially change the coming days. Objectively speaking, one day doesn't make a trend as this is an oversold bounce for now.

Looking at the dollar, big breakdown as price sliced through the 10, 20 and 50 MAs. Precious metals in relation see limp, but have definitely stopped going down - both Gold and Silver remain below the 200-SMA (downtrends).

In crypto land, pretty uninspiring action, as the daily charts in BTC/ETH look relatively benign - overall, does not seem like yesterday was truly risk-on but a rubber band that snapped back for now.

Staying light mostly remains the play as the market sorts itself out.

Notes:

> And there came the mean reversion that most were looking for. Vicious one day rallies in AI infrastructure stocks: +20-50% depending on the instrument traded.

> Looking outside of this space, very few in terms of constructive weekly bases in an overarching (new) theme. Generally still in wait and see mode.

> The biggest rallies often happen in countertrend moves - volatility needs to come down, setups need to proliferate, and higher lows need to be formed to break this thesis. Patience for now.

name: Art of Speculation
text:
下周开盘前需要知道的几件事
核心信号：标普Gamma从低位向上转移，市场在押注继续反弹
美股从美联储FOMC后的跳水中迅速反弹了170点。Gamma集中度从早前的低位快速向上转移，目前最大的正Gamma集中在标普7500这个关口，其次是7550和7600，说明衍生品交易员正在为下周开盘冲击7500到7600这个区间悄然布局。
VIX在过去三天持续下跌，重新被压制在20关口下方，市场重回典型的波动率压缩环境。

地缘政治：特朗普宣称已取消对伊朗的打击，但伊朗方面直接驳斥
特朗普在社交媒体上发文称已取消对伊朗的预定打击，并称双方达成了协议框架，包括全面恢复霍尔木兹海峡通行、消除伊朗核威胁。但伊朗军方和外交官员驳斥了这个说法，称这个是心理战和幻想清单，强调没有接受任何协议，霍尔木兹海峡仍处于安全管制状态，还表示美方取消打击是因为中东防空系统已经耗尽。美国国务院已经向中东地区的美国公民发布了安全警告，说明地缘不确定性依然高。

美债收益率狂飙，加息预期意外重燃
美国30年期国债收益率冲上5.27%，创下2007年6月以来最高水平。更值得警惕的是，美联储按兵不动之后，收益率不降反升。目前市场交易员对9月降息的预期破灭，现在在计入72%的概率美联储会加息25个基点，30年期房贷利率逼近7%到8%，对房地产和消费信贷造成了压制。华尔街对美联储政策路径的信心明显在动摇，这也是接下来几周需要持续跟踪的核心宏观变量。

美日15年来首次联合干预汇市
日本央行卖出590亿美元买入日元后，纽约联储与美联储罕见联手卖出欧元/美元买入日元，这是自2011年以来美日首次联合干预日元汇率，也是继此前日韩联合干预之后又一次央行层面的协同动作。这种频繁的干预打乱了套利交易的节奏，压力可能会进一步传导到美债市场的收益率波动上，值得持续关注。

标普技术面：SPY 749-750是关键分水岭
上方749到750是强心理和技术阻力位，现在夜盘751，看明天开盘能不能维持在上方。之前多次冲击都失败了(包括7月22日以及上周五盘中触及后回落)，如果能真正突破，大盘会迅速挑战760.40这个历史新高。下方740到741是短期双底支撑，如果跌破，大盘会下探到736甚至之前的近期低点727。

黄金：正Gamma恢复，期权市场出现重磅多头资金流
GLD正在尝试构成更大的底部，Gamma集中度开始重新转正，期权市场出现了非常明显的净资金流入(Call增持、Put卖出)，远期目标直接指向400甚至500这个行权价，单笔资金量达3000万美元以上。如果GLD能成功突破并站稳370到375这个阻力区，会接着冲400，值得作为一个独立于股市之外的观察标的。现在美元跌和债市涨对黄金来说是个利好。

本周宏观数据加密集财报
宏观数据方面，本周有JOLTs职位空缺、ISM服务业PMI，以及周五的非农就业报告，这三个数据会是验证现在的加息预期是否合理。

财报方面
周一Palantir盘后公布。
周二是全周焦点，AMD和SpaceX(新上市后的首批财报)、Arista、Astera Labs、Kratos都会盘后公布。
AMD这份财报我会重点看。现在股价在460-580之间震荡，这两个月都在横盘，Gamma主要集中在500(最大)、450以及600，但周五的期权净资金流明显偏负面，Put买盘和Call卖盘占主导，450和400处出现负Gamma，说明市场情绪偏谨慎，属于一个关键的转折点，如果财报不及预期，可能引发下行延续。
周三是SanDisk、西部数据这些存储/半导体产业链的财报。
周四盘前是Datadog，盘后是AAOI。

name: Clement Ang
text:
04 Aug 2026: LeoSold + Warsh-out Combo 👊👊

Market Commentary:

A potential higher low was made in the QQQ, with a brief morning washout to the 10-EMA paving the way for a trend day. Thematics that had resisted the decline the most throughout the carnage staged strong follow through action to the upside. Notably, intraday price action was clean, a confirmation that positioning have, for the most part - courtesy of LeoSold, been Warshed out.

Looking at the dollar, muted action after Japan and US's intervention, with price on the daily 'bear flagging' below the 10/20/50 MAs. Precious metals as of late has shown good relative strength despite trading below the 20, 50, and 200 MAs - both Gold and Silver (along with the miners) formed structural higher lows vs QQQ lower lows the past 2 weeks.

In crypto land, the majors refuse to break down as well, as the pattern continues to morph on the weekly chart - not much to do here for now.

Overall, a good first step in the right direction - now show us theme/setup proliferation in the coming days.

Notes:

> Refreshing price action, a very stark contrast compared to the past 2 months. The FAB 8 re-emergence has helped to establish a floor which is a positive sign. S&P 500 about to now make new all time highs.

> Strong thematics are still numbered but slowly increasing. Whilst it has not proliferated to the degree vs April 2026, there are still charts to work with. No cycle is the same, work around the edges and just manage risk.

> Two potential scenarios in my head: Sept 2024 onwards after the Yen carry trade crisis or late 2021 with FAB 8 carrying the market. I choose the former.

HAG1!
